name: Shaved Fennel, Bartlett Pear & Tatsoi Salad with Manchego (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Raw shaved fennel bulb, raw pear skins (high sorbitol), walnuts, and tatsoi greens are mechanically abrasive.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat only the aged Manchego cheese shavings (naturally lactose-free) or swap for the Pulled Guinea Hen Corn Chowder (strained).
watchOuts: Raw shaved fennel and tatsoi greens
